PASS OC-043 admission maintenance: stale/unauthorized shape and owner validation, atomic audit rollback, routed error/Datadog/Prometheus suppression, owner queue, exact expiry without timers, immutable originals, read-only replay and restart

Native routed public journey: bearer/HMAC, immutable retries, scope, per-service recovery, unrouted/readmission, zero-write replay, stale publication, audit rollback, rotation/revocation and secret-free checkpoint passed

PASS OC-043 correlation: Datadog/Prometheus/error labels, routed-first versions, immutable originals, exact event-time boundary, dependency/environment isolation, audit rollback, ordered zero-write replay, restart, flapping and explicit next-admission release
PASS OC-043 routed severity/priority transformation: OC-072 routing version then selected service version, original event, label action and zero-write replay table counts

PASS OC-043 urgency transformation: versioned explained lowering at new admission, unchanged severity and open high urgency, ordered correlation and both urgency decisions with zero durable/audit writes

PASS OC-043 severity/priority transformations: versioned reasoned lowering, open-alert floors, original fields, raising, duplicate identity, authority, stale/invalid zero writes, ordered replay table counts, audit rollback and restart

PASS OC-043 effective response classification: transformed severity selects response rule and declaration, original retained; recovery stops only the alert obligation and preserves human incident state

PASS OC-043 declared priority field: severity/priority raises from source priority and original classification; malformed priority stays in OC-059 high incomplete custody without transformation or declaration
PASS OC-043 ordered future replay: prior hypothetical raises protect the same generation with zero durable or permanent-audit writes
proof_provenance: The two targeted browser journeys used a Worker built from the exact candidate HEAD. The core browser and routing runs used identical app and test bytes before commit. The pre-push rebase reported the branch up to date, and the subsequent edition source lock and generated-document checks left the commit clean.
